items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Jimmy Cleveland went with him [Thelonious Monk].

ctx.x: I guess he was under a little pressure.
Well yeah. But Jimmy didn’t play the concert. He wasn’t in the band. But he was doing the copying I guess.
The concert was kind of a rough affair, wasn’t it?
